name: LiveLineChart.data
description: Streaming data — array of { time: unixSeconds, value }

name: LiveLineChart.value
description: Latest value (smoothly interpolated to)

name: LiveLineChart.dataKey
description: Key used for the value field in context data. Default: "value"

name: LiveLineChart.window
description: Visible time window in seconds. Default: 30

name: LiveLineChart.numXTicks
description: Number of X-axis ticks (used to compute leading offset). Default: 5

name: LiveLineChart.nowOffsetUnits
description: Leading offset in X-tick units (0 = now at right edge). Default: 0

name: LiveLineChart.exaggerate
description: Tight Y-axis. Default: false

name: LiveLineChart.lerpSpeed
description: Interpolation speed (0–1). Default: 0.08

name: LiveLineChart.margin
description: Chart margins

name: LiveLineChart.paused
description: Freeze chart scrolling. Default: false

name: LiveLineChart.children
description: Child components (LiveLine, Grid, ChartTooltip, LiveXAxis, LiveYAxis, etc.)

name: LiveLineChart.className
description: Optional composition API.

name: LiveLineChart.style
description: Optional composition API.

name: LiveLine.dataKey
description: Key in data to use for y values

name: LiveLine.stroke
description: Stroke color. Default: var(--chart-1)

name: LiveLine.strokeWidth
description: Stroke width. Default: 2

name: LiveLine.curve
description: Curve function. Default: curveMonotoneX

name: LiveLine.fill
description: Show gradient fill under the curve. Default: true

name: LiveLine.pulse
description: Show pulsing live dot at the right edge. Default: true

name: LiveLine.dotSize
description: Radius of the live dot. Default: 4

name: LiveLine.badge
description: Show value badge pill at the live tip. Default: true

name: LiveLine.formatValue
description: Value label formatter for the badge

name: LiveLine.momentumColors
description:
When set, the line/fill color changes based on momentum direction.
Overrides `stroke` for the line and fill (dot always uses momentum colors).

name: LiveXAxis.numTicks
description: Number of time labels. Default: 5

name: LiveXAxis.formatTime
description: Time formatter. Default: HH:MM:SS

name: LiveYAxis.minGap
description: Minimum pixel gap between labels. Default: 36

name: LiveYAxis.position
description: Position. Default: "left"

name: LiveYAxis.formatValue
description: Value formatter

name: LiveYAxis.allowDecimals
description: Allow decimal tick values. Default: true
